title: Reserve-SOC supervisory energy management for grid-diesel-battery drilling rig power systems under forecast uncertainty: reproducibility package
description: Compact code, configuration, simulated-data, audit, and manuscript-support package for reserve-SOC supervisory energy management. The 72 h record and all evaluation holdouts were generated by a single mechanistic simulator; no synchronized target-rig measurements were used. Conclusions are limited to the specified simulated system and comparison protocol. Code is licensed under MIT; author-generated simulated data, results, audit artifacts, and repository documentation are licensed under CC BY 4.0.
